cohort: Pregnant patients undergoing caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia, divided into pre-eclamptic and non-pre-eclamptic groups.
finding: A higher incidence of hypotension was observed in the non-pre-eclamptic group compared to the pre-eclamptic group, and abdominal circumference showed no correlation with post-spinal hypotension in either group.
cross-section timing: During caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia
